- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports CPF Additional Wage ceiling formula and Ordinary Wage offset): Wages which are not classified as Ordinary Wages will be Additional Wages for the month. The applicable amount depends on the wages subject to CPF in the relevant year; a personal ceiling requires those payroll facts.
- Official source: [What Is the Additional Wage Ceiling? | Central Provident Fund Board (CPF Board) (offline fixture title)](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/article/what-is-the-additional-wage-aw-ceiling)

#### Ministry of Manpower — Employment requirements

**Status:** Verified evidence; case application unresolved

**Facts that determine whether a salary deduction is permitted** (party in scope: Not established)
- **Application unresolved:** For Facts that determine whether a salary deduction is permitted, case-specific treatment or calculation has not been verified. The relevant facts and statutory conditions still need to be established.

**Source:** Salary Deductions | Ministry of Manpower (MOM) (offline fixture title) (live external)
- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports Facts that determine whether a salary deduction is permitted): For employees covered by the Employment Act, salary deductions are permitted only on specified grounds. Deductions for damage or loss require the employer to establish the employee’s direct fault and give the employee an opportunity to explain; that deduction is limited to 25% of one month’s salary on one occasion. Normal authorised deductions are generally capped at half of salary for a salary period; exceptions include absence, loan or advance repayment, overpayment recovery and cooperative payments. Authorised final-payment deductions may exceed the normal cap. Employee consent is not universal permission to deduct, and foreign-worker levy recovery is not permitted.
- Official source: [Salary Deductions | Ministry of Manpower (MOM) (offline fixture title)](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/salary-deductions)

outcomes.response:
### Statutory Compliance & Legal Authority

**Whole-question status:** Evidence verified for mapped issues; full request coverage unconfirmed.

#### Monetary Authority of Singapore — Financial regulation

**Status:** Evidence verified

**SFA-regulated fund management activity and LFMC CMS licensing requirement** (party in scope: Company)
- **MAS rule explanation:** A company conducting fund management activities regulated under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 must apply to be a licensed fund management company holding a Capital Markets Services licence. A company that can operate under an existing class exemption does not require a licence. [Fund Management Licensing | Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) (offline fixture title)](https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/capital-markets/apply-for-licensing-or-registration-of-capital-market-entities/fund-management-licensing)

**Source:** Fund Management Licensing | Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) (offline fixture title) (live external)
- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports SFA-regulated fund management activity and LFMC CMS licensing requirement): If your company wishes to conduct fund management activities regulated under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 (SFA), it must apply to be a licensed fund management company (LFMC) that holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) licence. If your company is able to operate under an existing class exemption, it does not require a licence. A company which solely manages venture capital funds may apply under the simplified VCFM regime, subject to the relevant admission criteria. Class exemptions are conditional, not automatic; examples include specified related-corporation or related-family-member activity, and managing immovable assets or non-capital-markets products for accredited or institutional investors. They do not exempt every fund manager.
- Official source: [Fund Management Licensing | Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) (offline fixture title)](https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/capital-markets/apply-for-licensing-or-registration-of-capital-market-entities/fund-management-licensing)
